_comment: Codex runs the SAME hook scripts as Claude Code (.claude/hooks/). There is no second copy to drift: .codex/hooks/*.py were deleted 2026-07-28 after no-app-server.py -- the guard that stops an agent seizing the recorder lock out from under a live practice session -- shipped to .claude/settings.json on 2026-07-26 and never reached the Codex mirror. tests/test_agent_config_parity.py fails if the two harnesses stop running the same set. Paths are repo-relative on purpose: the absolute C:\Users\... paths this file held until 2026-07-28 work in exactly one checkout on one machine.
